name: NFEPP
summary: NFEPP (N-(3-fluoro-1-phenethylpiperidin-4-yl)-N-phenylpropionamide) is an analgesic opioid chemical, similar in structure to fentanyl, designed in 2016 by Spahn et al. from Free University of Berlin to avoid the standard negative side effects of opiates, including opioid overdose, by only targeting inflamed tissue.

pharmacology.text: Computer models suggest fentanyl binds to μ-opioid receptors in its protonated form. Fluorination of fentanyl at the 3-position lowers the pKa of its conjugate acid from 8.4 to 6.8, a change designed to reduce its systemic effects while maintaining its potency in inflamed tissue, as this is a more acidic environment (pH 5–7) than non-inflamed tissue (pH 7.4).

sideEffects.text: NFEPP (N-(3-fluoro-1-phenethylpiperidin-4-yl)-N-phenylpropionamide) is an analgesic opioid chemical, similar in structure to fentanyl, designed in 2016 by Spahn et al. from Free University of Berlin to avoid the standard negative side effects of opiates, including opioid overdose, by only targeting inflamed tissue.

uses.en: It is a research compound, studied as a possible painkiller that would not slow breathing. It is not an approved medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，被研究作為不會抑制呼吸的可能止痛藥，目前並非核准藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，被研究作为不会抑制呼吸的可能止痛药，目前并非核准药物。

fact.en: NFEPP was designed in Berlin in 2016 on a clever idea: injured, inflamed tissue is slightly more acidic than healthy tissue, so a drug tuned to work only in acid should relieve pain at the injury without acting on the brain.
fact.zh: NFEPP 於 2016 年在柏林設計，概念相當巧妙：受傷發炎的組織比健康組織略為偏酸，因此一種只在酸性環境下作用的藥物，就能在傷處止痛而不作用於大腦。
fact.zhHans: NFEPP 于 2016 年在柏林设计，概念相当巧妙：受伤发炎的组织比健康组织略为偏酸，因此一种只在酸性环境下作用的药物，就能在伤处止痛而不作用于大脑。
